notes.title: Yakuza 3 может получить полноценный ремейк, Sega уже приступила к работе над Yakuza 9
notes.content: Разработка следующей игры в основном сериале Like a Dragon (Yakuza) уже ведется, но никакими деталями авторы делиться пока не готовы, сообщил геймдиректор студии Ryu Ga Gotoku Масаеси Ёкояма. Известно лишь, что Sega снова будет выбирать девушек на роли виртуальных хостес среди простых японок — готовится серия кастингов.

notes.title: Patch Now Live – 3/26/2021
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Our latest patch is now live. Thanks to everyone that participated in our beta!

This patch addresses the below issues:

[list]
[*] Missing SFX in bars. 
[*] Distorted window images.
[*] High CPU usage. 
[*] Loud or glitching audio sounds. 
[*] Certain windows shortcuts do not function when system language is set to Japanese or Traditional Chinese. 
[*] F12 not functioning when system language is set to Japanese or Traditional Chinese.
[*] Issue with the sort function when using item box. 
[*] Occasional crash during Heat Actions. 
[*] Infinite loading screen for Club Shine/Jewel. 
[/list]

As always, if you have feedback about the patch, please reply to the thread here. For everything else, please take it to the dedicated thread in the Steam Forums.

- SEGA Team

notes.title: Open Beta for Hotfix Patch - 3/19/2021
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
 
We have identified several bugs within the game as well as our plan to address them.
 
[b]Issues to be fixed:[/b]
•	Missing SFX in bars. 
•	Distorted window images.
•	High CPU usage. 
•	Loud or glitching audio sounds. 
•	Certain windows shortcuts do not function when system language is set to Japanese or Traditional Chinese. 
•	F12 not functioning when system language is set to Japanese or Traditional Chinese.
•	Issue with the sort function when using item box. 
•	Occasional crash during Heat Actions. 
•	Infinite loading screen for Club Shine/Jewel. 
 
[b]Open Beta[/b]
This weekend, we will be hosting an open beta with a patch implementing the above fixes. If you've encountered these bugs and would like to opt-in to this patch prior to deployment, please follow the instructions below.
1.	In your Steam library, right click the game and go to Properties.
2.	Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code. Each game has a unique access code.
3.	ZQvs5UCX53Y7E2pJ
4.	From the drop down menu, select “hotfix_beta”
5.	You will be in the beta the next time you launch the game.

If you haven't encountered these problems, we recommend not joining this beta branch.
 
Please use this thread to communicate any issues that you encounter while on this beta branch. For everything else, please take it to the dedicated threads in the Steam Forums.
 
As always, thank you for your support. Your feedback helps us make our games the best they can be.


- Team SEGA

notes.title: Patch Now Live – February 19, 2021
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Our latest patch is live. Thanks to everyone that participated in our beta, we appreciate your support! 

This patch addresses the below issues: 

[list]
[*] Proper dedicated GPU detection so that the game won’t try to launch on integrated GPUs. 
[*] Setting ‘Auto’ as default framerate settings. 
[*] High CPU usage thread – CPU usage has been cut down by ~30%. 
[*] Random crash when ending fights with Heat Move – we managed to fix a crash occurring occasionally after finishing battles with a Heat Action.
[*] Fishing minigame fixes - invalid timings for reels and catches, UI out of the screen when Render Scale set to 200%.
[/list]

As always, if you have feedback about the patch, please reply to the thread here. For everything else, please take it to the dedicated threads in the Steam Forums.

- Team SEGA

notes.title: Open Beta for Hotfix Patch - Feb 12th, 2021
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We hope you’re having fun trouncing goons in Kamurocho. As always, thank you for reporting bugs over at the Steam Forums. Your feedback helps us make our games the best they can be.  

We have identified how we will fix several reported issues, listed below: 

[b]Fixes[/b]

Proper dedicated GPU detection so that the game won’t try to launch on integrated GPUs.  

Setting ‘Auto’ as default framerate settings.  

High CPU usage thread – CPU usage has been cut down by ~30%.  

Random crash when ending fights with Heat Move – we managed to fix a crash occurring occasionally after finishing battles with a Heat Action. 

Fishing minigame fixes - invalid timings for reels and catches, UI out of the screen when Render Scale set to 200%.  

[b]Open Beta[/b]

This weekend, we will be hosting an open beta with a patch implementing the above fixes. If you've encountered these bugs and would like to opt-in to this patch prior to deployment, please follow the instructions below.  

From Yakuza 3 Remastered in your Steam library, right click and go to Properties.  

Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code. Each game has a unique access code. 

Yakuza 3: ZQvs5UCX53Y7E2pJ 

From the drop down menu, select “hotfix_beta” 

You are now in the beta. 

If you haven't encountered these problems, we recommend not joining this beta branch.  

Please reply to this thread with any additional issues or errors you encounter while on this beta branch. For everything else, please take it to the dedicated threads in the Steam Forums. 

Thanks, and we appreciate your help! 

- Team SEGA
